title: Compare two async call structures
description: You can inspect sequential awaits, gather, and a small generator-resumption illustration.

steps.description: fetch_data prints a start message, awaits a simulated wait, and returns a source-labelled string. It performs no network request.
main_sequential awaits server_A's result before it calls fetch_data for server_B.

steps.question: Which call receives both fetch coroutines together?
steps.answer: asyncio.gather receives both calls and returns their two results.

steps.description: The supplied concurrent recording shows both start messages before either finish message. Both drivers receive the same source-labelled strings.
The final illustrative driver calls next twice around a work message. Its recording shows a yield message, the driver's work, and then the resumed message.
